name: Nebalite
description: The Nebalites were a species of starfighter-sized sentient cephalopod. Nebalites had starships constructed that enveloped their bodies like suits of clothing. Grazdoc was a Nebalite trader who operated in a sector of the Unknown Regions and employed X-17-D, a small protocol droid who could not speak but could communicate through gestures, as an intermediary for face-to-face interactions.
